headword: {日帰|ひがえ}り{温泉|おんせん}
gloss: day-trip hot spring, hot spring for day use

definitions.gloss: day-trip hot spring, hot spring bath for day use
definitions.explanation: A hot spring facility that can be enjoyed without an overnight stay, allowing visitors to bathe and return home the same day.

examples.japanese: {日帰|ひがえ}り{温泉|おんせん}に{行|い}こう。
examples.english: Let's go to a day-trip hot spring.

examples.japanese: この{旅館|りょかん}は{日帰|ひがえ}り{温泉|おんせん}も{利用|りよう}できる。
examples.english: This inn also offers day-use hot spring bathing.

examples.japanese: {休日|きゅうじつ}に{家族|かぞく}で{近|ちか}くの{日帰|ひがえ}り{温泉|おんせん}に{行|い}って{疲|つか}れを{取|と}った。
examples.english: On my day off, I went to a nearby day-trip hot spring with my family to relieve our fatigue.

notes:
A popular leisure activity in Japan, referring to visiting a hot spring ({温泉|おんせん}) facility for bathing without staying overnight. Many {旅館|りょかん} and dedicated facilities offer {日帰|ひがえ}り plans at a lower cost than full stays.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日帰|ひがえ}り{温泉|おんせん}に{行|い}く: to go to a day-trip hot spring
- {日帰|ひがえ}り{温泉|おんせん}{施設|しせつ}: day-use hot spring facility
- {日帰|ひがえ}り{入浴|にゅうよく}: day-use bathing

USAGE:
Often shortened to {日帰|ひがえ}り{入浴|にゅうよく} (day bathing) or {立|た}ち{寄|よ}り{湯|ゆ} (drop-in bath). Signs at hot spring resorts commonly advertise {日帰|ひがえ}りOK or {日帰|ひがえ}り{可|か} to indicate day use is available.
